description: Fetch Known Good's dated verification report for one listed website: which capabilities were tested, which passed, when it was probed, what an agent can apparently do there, and how the site was found: whether it declared agent access, came from probe discovery, or was submitted. Answers "is this specific host agent-ready?". Returns found:false for anything not in the index — it never guesses a nearest match. Cite the report URL and its date.

host.description: The site's hostname or URL, e.g. example.com

name: get_site_report
title: Fetch one site's verification report
